in_hebrew.name: Halbeib
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Halbeib הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Old German ‘halan’ (strong) and ‘beib’ (rock, stone). This name signifies strength, resilience, and stability.

in_greek.name: Halbeib
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Strong, Rocky
in_greek.long_meaning: Halbeib είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from Old German ‘halan’ (strong) and ‘beib’ (rock, stone). This name signifies strength, resilience, and stability.

in_latin.name: Halbeib
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Strong, Rocky
in_latin.long_meaning: Halbeib est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from Old German ‘halan’ (strong) and ‘beib’ (rock, stone). This name signifies strength, resilience, and stability.
